issues.detail: Threads TH1 (14 msgs), TH3 (12 msgs), TH4 (12 msgs), and TH5 (13 msgs) are below the absolute min_msgs_per_thread of 15. Additionally, all threads fall short of their specific target_messages_range minimums defined in the blueprint.
Thread TH5 is missing a reference to mandatory artifact T6 in its messages.
Thread TH4 thread_outcome.next_steps contains artifact IDs (A3, A8, A1) instead of valid task IDs from the backlog.
